notes.title: Improved main menu with animated gummy vegetation. Also, new gun preview!
notes.content:
[p][b]Version 0.2.0[/b] of the prototype contains new gummy candy vegetation, integrated in the improved main menu.[/p][p]Background [b]candy vegetation[/b] is now reacting to the UI. Notice the [b]gummy hammer tree[/b] on the left. A potential hostile "tree" you will encounter in the future?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535579/3573877ce763b5694e1234559a45239572512edf.gif"][/img][/p][p]For reference, this was the [b]old main menu[/b]... Pretty ugly but did serve its purpose:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535579/1a14aed4dc3b9bbedef0e7a53538f711a6287d4b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Now lets get to the [b]candy-themed gun[/b]!
Imagine a rapid fire candy dispenser, shooting gumballs... Well, here are some preview images of a work in progress [b]gumball SMG[/b] 3D model:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535579/90c95dfb42b772bfffd7e3294c19d98f27a5a46a.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535579/859750e9f819e6a502a55f887bdd1ce0bfc612be.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535579/462db6abac47bf09fb52906994809378097a5858.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535579/da07ab4d8130e6b5c63585c90f9889304a9f2f2a.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Rogue Candy at the Baltic Games Fest 2025!
notes.content:
It was a pleasure to showcase the prototype of "Rogue Candy" to the public for the very first time at the Baltic Games Fest. Seeing players enjoy it and receiving valuable feedback for future improvements was truly amazing! Great vibes, great studios and great people.
